doc.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007

title: Singers who influenced him
summary: Lellis names Mel Torme, Sinatra, Ella, Sarah Vaughan, Carmen McRae and others as singers who conveyed emotion through time.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: In your opinion, who is a good example of that?

Wow. There was a lot, but I mean my first influences were Mel Torme, Sinatra, Ella, Sarah Vaughan, Carmen McRae, Billy Eckstine, even Vic Damone, Jack Jones, Joe Williams. So those people, whether specific tunes or in general, they either swung or were romantic and were able to carry these emotions – whatever they were singing —
they were able to convey that emotion. And I think a lot of it is in the time, as much as in the phrasing and the notation, you know?
